# FLX-5035: the committed slice cannot be read as a committed state

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

SEAM-FIDELITY-SPEC §4: the owner fixes the record set as a file:// slice. The slice was unreadable, carried a scheme other than file://, held a line that is not one JSON object, carried a binary floating-point number, or held more records than records.max leaves room to commit.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5035
```
